name: Clip Slice Cards
description: Grid of monospace report cards that reveal a background image cut into sliding slices on hover, with scrambled-character text flicker. Rows use different slice counts and directions.
contents: Large split title and subtitle line
Grid of cards, each with date, title, link label and a sliced background image
behavior: On hover the image enters as vertical or horizontal slices that slide in with staggered offsets, and slides out on leave
Date, title and link characters flicker through random characters on hover
Whole component fades in once the images have loaded
Each group of cards uses the next slice configuration from the configs list
Grid collapses to one column below the breakpoint
